description: Troubleshooting procedure for an insufficient gap measurement between an input part and its assembly fixture nest.

box_1.text: Do all 8 parts fit correctly in or on the fixtures?

box_2.text: Reference: play and burr inspection, part to fixture fit.

box_3.text: Identify and replace the faulty fixture on the indexing table that is causing the incorrect part fit.

box_4.text: Are the 8 fixtures themselves securely fastened?

box_5.text: Fasten all fixtures securely to eliminate play in their seating on the indexing table.

box_6.text: Is the height measurement at station 8 or 11 properly adjusted?

box_8.text: Measure the part gap dimensions at the relevant station using a caliper to determine the extent of the deviation.

box_9.text: Complete the following steps: 1. Remove all parts from the current batch. 2. Introduce a replacement input batch and perform a new full sample measurement. 3. Report non conforming parts via the team leader for escalation to the quality assurance team at shift handover.
